limitations: Linear OAuth applications support organization-level authorization. Webhooks and admin actions require explicit approval from a workspace admin.

assumptions: Developer has an active Linear account and workspace membership
Setting up OAuth 2.0 app with read, write, and issues:create scopes

externalWait.publishedRange: Instant activation (no review required for public or private Linear OAuth apps)

prerequisites.text: Active Linear account with access to a team workspace

steps.title: Create OAuth Application in Linear Settings
steps.instructions: Log into Linear and navigate to `https://linear.app/settings/api/applications`. Click 'Create Application'. Fill in the Application Name, Developer/Company name, and Website URL.
steps.completionCheck: Application created; Client ID displayed in settings.

steps.title: Configure Callback Redirect URLs
steps.instructions: In your Linear application settings, enter your Callback URLs. Linear requires HTTPS URLs for production (localhost is permitted for development). Multiple redirect URLs can be listed separated by commas or lines.
steps.completionCheck: Callback URLs saved without wildcard patterns.

steps.title: Secure Client Secret
steps.instructions: Click to generate or copy your Client Secret. Store it immediately into your backend vault or environment file (`LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET`). Never expose this secret to browser code.
steps.completionCheck: Client secret stored safely on backend.

steps.title: Execute OAuth 2.0 Code Flow with PKCE
steps.instructions: Send users to `https://linear.app/oauth/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&response_type=code&scope=read,write&actor=application`. After user authorization, exchange the code at `https://api.linear.app/oauth/token` with `grant_type=authorization_code`.
steps.completionCheck: Access token received for GraphQL API access at https://api.linear.app/graphql.

claims.text: Linear OAuth applications are created in user settings at https://linear.app/settings/api/applications.
Linear enforces strict redirect URI matching and requires HTTPS for production environments.
Linear issues confidential Client Secrets that must be kept secret on backend servers.
Linear authorization endpoint is https://linear.app/oauth/authorize and token endpoint is https://api.linear.app/oauth/token.
